issue_request: FHIR-15938 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested adding DeviceUseStatement as a context for the event-statusReason extension so a not-done DeviceUseStatement can carry the reason it was not done.
initial_application: Core commit c82cf3a67bd4b0a68e69b77477740182e93b8f06 names GF#15938 and changed source/profiles/event-extensions-spreadsheet.xml so the statusReason extension Resource context included DeviceUseStatement. Before that commit, the statusReason row listed Observation, DiagnosticReport, Media, SupplyDelivery, DeviceRequest, ServiceRequest, NutritionOrder, and SupplyRequest, but not DeviceUseStatement.
additional_context: FHIR-31478 later renamed DeviceUseStatement to DeviceUsage. In the current core checkout, DeviceUseStatement appears as an R4-R6 change-map alias to DeviceUsage, DeviceUsage is not an active core resource entry in source/fhir.ini, and current core narrative links DeviceUsage to the OO incubator IG. The maintained event-statusReason definition is in the FHIR Extension Pack, where the current source includes a DeviceUsage context for FHIR 5.0+ and a version-bounded legacy DeviceUseStatement context. FHIR-53001/2f85c5e added that legacy DeviceUseStatement context in the Extension Pack.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. No core source was changed because the seed request is already represented in the repository that now owns the extension definition, while DeviceUsage/DeviceUseStatement is outside the active current core resource build.
